text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Quasiequilibrium path family. Interpreting n=1 as isothermal or n=k as isentropic requires the ideal-gas model; n=k also uses constant heat capacities and
reversible adiabatic conditions. Work can be integrated for any given P(v) path.
